title: A closed output never crashes specsync or hides its exit status
description: a closed output never crashes specsync or hides its exit status
no_spec_change_rationale: Makes behavior match REQ-cli (exit 0 on success, 1 on errors); the specs gain only error-case rows
acceptance_criteria: With its stdout (or stderr) reader gone, specsync drops further output to that stream and exits with the command's own status, 0 or 1, never a panic or exit 101; watch stops once nobody reads its output; any other write error still panics

answers.constraints: REQ-cli exit codes: 0 on success, 1 on errors; a panic is a reported bug
